Relayed photo of dime-size hail near 4000 Grand Ave.

Florida Forest Service reports that the Solar Field wildfire in southern Hendry County has grown to 600 acres with a containment of 30%.
Social media image depicts a funnel cloud associated with a thunderstorm near LaBelle.
The Solar Field Wildfire is at 100% containment with a final acreage of 724 acres.
Social media post showed several flooded roads in Riviera Beach due to heavy rainfall. This includes US 1 and Congress Ave.
*** 2 INJ *** Ocean Rescue helped two individuals caught in a rip current in Boynton Beach Saturday afternoon. Both individuals were treated on scene.
